title: every truncation of the file is a shorter prefix or a refusal
description: For each `length` in 0..=fileLength, open the first `length` bytes of `journal.bin` from AF-CONF-JOURNAL-003. An empty file is a new journal. A partial magic is not a journal. A cut inside a frame is a torn tail: the complete frames before it replay and the rest is discarded and reported. A cut on a frame boundary is clean.
